title: GraphPathsRow
description: One row of graph.paths: one of the k best simple propagation paths from a candidate node to an entry service, against the call direction. Produced by Causalith for every node that can reach an entry (03 §6.3, 05 §3.6).

candidate.description: Node the path starts at (a graph.nodes.node).

path_rank.description: Rank of the path for this candidate; 1 = best, ranks 1..k without gaps (05 §3.6).

nodes.description: Path nodes in order candidate -> ... -> entry (reverse call direction); an entry's own path is [entry]. At least one node; never sorted (contract_changes B).

anomalous_fraction.description: Anomalous nodes on the path / nodes on the path; a node is anomalous if it has an above-threshold anomalies row with (robust_z, external) or (silence, external or context) (05 §3.6).
